root_cause_label: Insufficient Jaxley API knowledge causing incorrect channel implementations and cascading runtime errors that were never resolved
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent implemented custom Jaxley channel classes (KC, CAD) and an add_channels() method with incorrect API signatures and wrong group-access patterns that caused cascading runtime errors the agent could never fix, ultimately declaring success without ever running the code successfully.
t_err_evidence: At step 25, the agent creates jaxley_conversion_new.py (moved to jaxley_conversion.py at step 26) with custom KC and CAD channel classes using incorrect Jaxley Channel API signatures (e.g., compute_current(v, params) instead of the actual Jaxley signature), and add_channels() iterating over self.cell.group_nodes[section_type] as a list of branch objects, which is incompatible with how Jaxley groups work. These incorrect patterns are committed to the target file.
t_commit_evidence: At step 26, the agent runs 'mv /app/jaxley_conversion_new.py /app/jaxley_conversion.py', replacing the target file with the incorrectly implemented code. From this point, the implementation is locked into the wrong channel API patterns and group-access logic, and subsequent errors are all downstream of this bad code.
t_surface_evidence: At step 46, the first observable failure from the channel code surfaces: 'TypeError: argument of type NoneType is not iterable' at add_channels line 'if section_type in self.cell.group_nodes', revealing that group_nodes is None and the channel insertion loop never executes. Earlier errors (steps 31, 37, 41) were from generating_from_swc.py changes, not the channel code itself.
trigger_explanation: The agent lacked knowledge of the correct Jaxley Channel subclass API (correct method signatures for compute_current, update_states, init_state) and how group_nodes works in Jaxley (it is not directly iterable as a dict of branch lists). The agent guessed at the API structure without verifying against the actual Jaxley source code, producing channel implementations that cannot work.
forewarning_evidence: Step 9: import jaxley fails with ModuleNotFoundError in the IPython venv. Steps 10-16: agent tries pip install repeatedly targeting the wrong Python environment (system python 3.11 vs venv python 3.12). Steps 22-24: editor string replacement fails twice. These repeated failures signal the agent is operating without full understanding of the environment and API.
